title: New colour
content: I saw a new colour. Ok let me try to explain. It was on a beach behind the city. Natural sandstone wall and it was windy but warm. There was an old guy there and we were sitting on the beach. He poured a bag of pebbles between us on the sand. They looked like green and brown like smooth glass. Then wow omg i saw a colour that isnt real. It doesnt exsist. The guy smiled like hes amused and he told me the reason i cant remember that or take it home.. it seemed to make perfect sence and i understood why id forget. Knowing smile betwern us and i left. Anyone else do something like this? I still cant shake the feeling of been totally in awe of seeing this new colour.. dreams are weird 😁
